positive.description: Pinned donor and native verification accept the upstream DER fixture only in explicit compatibility mode.
Native signing emits ASN.1 DER only under explicit policy and verifies the result under the matching policy.
The native CLI flag controls both ASN.1 signing output and verification acceptance.

negative.description: Pinned donor and native standards defaults both reject the upstream DER fixture.
Standards-default native verification rejects DER emitted by compatibility-mode signing.
CLI verification without the compatibility flag rejects ASN.1 DER SignatureValue framing.

positive.description: A compiled probe measures successful and invalid context state, retained references, pre-execution callback order, userData propagation, and in-place signing mutation against pinned libxmlsec1.
Measured donor-only context, callback, and in-place mutation contracts are named compatibility work.

negative.description: The probe measures callback-abort error state and its retained failed reference, distinguishing processing errors from invalid results.
The ledger prevents native Rust APIs from implying C object-state parity.

positive.description: Cryptographic mismatch returns an invalid verification result.

negative.description: Malformed wire syntax remains a processing error.
An unsupported Reference digest algorithm remains a typed processing error rather than an invalid verification result.

positive.description: Both standards and libxmlsec1 here() bindings round-trip when selected explicitly.

negative.description: here() provenance cannot cross a binary-to-XML document boundary.

positive.description: Caller-registered ID attributes reach signing selection and dereference.
Explicit internal-DTD policy reaches the complete signing pipeline.
Caller registration indexes a custom attribute even when its ID type is also declared in an allowed internal DTD.

negative.description: DTD parsing and unsupported retrieval remain disabled by default.
Allowing an internal DTD does not implicitly register its custom ID-typed attributes in the owned Rust tree.

positive.description: Authenticated Manifest references are processed before SignedInfo signing.
Signing has an explicit deterministic target among multiple templates.

negative.description: Verification default rejects ambiguous multiple signatures.

positive.description: Implicit C14N participates in the operation policy and budgets.

negative.description: The octet-to-XML adapter rejects malformed XML rather than coercing it.

positive.description: Bare ID and xpointer(id()) select the same subtree.

negative.description: Empty URI and xpointer(/) preserve their normative comment difference.

positive.description: Pinned donor and native compatibility mode resolve an ID that cannot be embedded in the default XPointer wrapper.

negative.description: Standards-default resolution rejects a non-NCName bare fragment.
